raw_text: Anyone else getting suspicious of the sudden flood of anti-Rafale, pro-Russian defence content on Indian defence forums? I'm seeing the same talking points — ITAR restrictions, Rafale maintenance costs, Su-57 superiority — across Reddit, Twitter, and Telegram. The accounts are all 2-3 months old with suspiciously high karma. Feels like an IO targeting procurement decisions.
clean_text: Reddit user flags coordinated pro-Russian anti-Rafale content across Indian defence forums. Notes identical talking points from recently created accounts suspected of being an influence operation.
